title: Verify European dynamic transfer routine and native dispatch
changes: Add a focused Wine verification of the original dynamic selector routine and queue executor against the managed fragment owner and translated dispatch.
validation: Thirty isolated cases cover selectors 7, 8 and 9, both table branches and five language slots; original queue sources, destinations and 64-byte DMA transfers match, with complete state and guest clock equal across raw interpreter, typed interpreter and typed native execution.

All 1304 dynamic source bytes were poisoned in both typed arms; guarded ROM, accepted dataset, TCC, executables and selected source inputs stayed unchanged. One isolated Windows test build and one Wine filter passed.
limitations: Isolated cases do not establish ordinary gameplay reachability, full selector domain, full helper ABI or direct-native coverage for every instruction. Linux, USA and native Windows remain pending; no performance measurement.
